# Radar fixtures

`claude_stream_websearch.jsonl` is a real `claude -p --output-format stream-json --verbose` run of one WebSearch call (query: terapie červeným světlem panel), taken on 2026-10-23. Only the three events the parser reads are kept: the tool call, the tool result and the final result. Identifiers and timings were removed; links and summary are exactly as returned.
